# Antifreeze types and specifications for Nissans

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Use P-HOAT ethylene glycol based with a 50/50 blend protecting freeze point to -34 degrees. [t501]

## Parts

- P-HOAT Antifreeze: Proprietary Phosphated Hybrid Organic Acid Technology, typically Blue or Pink [t501]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use P-HOAT for Nissans as it contains organic additives and phosphate but lacks silicates, borates, nitrites, and amines. [t501]
- [Partial] Ensure the product is ethylene glycol based with a 50/50 blend protecting freeze point to -34 degrees. [t501]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using a HOAT-based product in a system designed for conventional green antifreeze without proper transition. [t501]
